What is Helpless?

It was originally recorded and released by Diamond Head in 1980 on the Lightning to the Nations album.

I gotta see you moving fast See you come my way See the dreams, I hope they last Never fade away.

Gotta see the lights above Make it loud tonight Gotta set it all a-fire Set it all a-light

See the flashing lights Hear the thunder roar I am gonna set you all a-light Gotta make it man I ain't got a choice Gotta fill this hall tonight
